standing: Required pure-identity registry-closure policy identified by independent Grok review. Not installed live. Not a substitute for a successor selection. check_dependencies.py remains contracts-only and must not be reused as if it covered identity.
architectureBasis: docs/v2/architecture/14-repository-and-module-layout.md: identity may use explicitly reviewed pure external libraries; no OS, provider, store or report UI dependency

docs/v2/architecture/implementation-boundaries-and-build-plan.md Enforcement 1: compare direct Cargo normal/build/dev/target/feature edges to the inventory graph; inspect transitive effects/build scripts of pure-layer external libraries

docs/v2/architecture/implementation-boundaries-and-build-plan.md tooling: Cargo metadata plus explicit source/build rules; a dependency list alone does not prove purity; record license/dependency closures when a candidate is selected

docs/v2/architecture/implementation-boundaries-and-build-plan.md Rust workspace policy: shared pure packages must resolve in the pinned provider workspace without inheriting host compiler/dependency settings

docs/implementation/m2/foundation-primitives-selection-v2: target-filtered metadata versions/sources/features must match the selected closure; default features that are unused must be disabled (libc lesson); identity currently adds no extra serializer/dependency without selection
canonical-02 / software-hash-01: sha2-const-stable =0.1.0 exact version, lock checksum equals .crate, no build.rs, no FFI, empty normal deps, source-review file hashes
whyContractsCheckerIsInsufficient: tools/check_dependencies.py hard-codes subjectPackage opensip-contracts and tools/contracts/dependency-policy.json
contracts selected closure includes std, proc-macro, and build-script packages (serde_derive, proc-macro2, syn, zmij, serde build.rs) under ACCEPT-BUILD-HOST-EFFECTS / ACCEPT-BOUNDED-NATIVE-TCB
identity forbid(unsafe_code) + no_std forbids that contracts TCB from being treated as identity's registry allowlist
contracts checker does not refuse custom-build targets, std features, proc-macro packages, or Unicode-version drift
contracts checker compares lock checksums but does not rehash registry archives or pin identity-local sources
inventory internal edges (check_package_edges.py) do not cover registry packages at all

requiredChecker.name: identity registry-closure check (sibling of check_dependencies.py, separate policy file)
inputs: cargo metadata --locked --offline --format-version 1 --filter-platform <target> from the identity-containing workspace
must: exactly one local opensip-identity library production target
walk identity's production resolve (exclude kind=dev and cfg(any()) version-coupling edges)
every non-local package in the walk must appear in policy.dependencies with matching version, registry source, and lock checksum
resolved feature lists must equal policy.resolvedFeatures exactly (including empty default if metadata emits it)
no target kind custom-build unless an explicit reviewed exception exists (none in the proposed NFC closure)
no proc-macro package in the production walk
unicode-normalization must resolve with features [] (std off); identity Cargo.toml must declare default-features=false
tinyvec must be an exact version/checksum, not the upstream version "1" float
sha2-const-stable 0.1.0 remains in the allowlist with features []
identity local source census (Cargo.toml + src/** regular files, no symlinks) like contracts schemaVersion 2 localSources
refuse extra registry packages, feature expansion, and missing allowlist members
mustNot: treat a passing contracts check as identity purity
claim OS-sandbox or memory-safety proof from a metadata match
beyondMetadataReviewStillRequired: source-review file hashes of extracted registry trees
Hangul from_u32_unchecked in unicode-normalization 0.1.24 (identity forbid does not audit deps)
license identifiers including tinyvec Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT
UNICODE_VERSION (16,0,0) matching selected Python 3.14.6 unidata 16.0.0; refuse 0.1.25 / Unicode 17
NFC API restricted to is_nfc / nfc iterator; NFKC and stream-safe unused
provider-lane lock must resolve the same identity registry tuples

proposedProductionRegistryClosure.name: tinyvec
proposedProductionRegistryClosure.role: transitive of 0.1.24; exact pin required because upstream req is "1"

graph06Observation.graph06OwnStanding: README: selection/source policy required before live; not a formal dependency policy selection

manifestPinGap: Identity Cargo.toml pins unicode-normalization =0.1.24 but does not pin tinyvec. Lock currently holds 1.13.3. Policy plus --locked must freeze tinyvec; a future cargo update without lock discipline can pull 1.x including 1.13.2 tinyvec_macros. Prefer an explicit identity tinyvec = { version = "=1.13.3", default-features = false, features = ["alloc"] } or equivalent lock-enforced successor so the float cannot move.
